# Help and feedback

- [Suggest an account](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=account.yml).
- [Correct a handle, description, or source; request removal](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=correction.yml).
- For generation problems, provide your Python version, command, and error with sensitive details removed.
- For translations, identify the locale, affected account or document, and suggested wording.

See the [maintenance guide](docs/maintenance.md). This project provides reading entry points and editorial summaries. Contact the relevant tool project for product support and read the original author's context for account content.
